title: Constitutional avoidance in defining delegated power
shortTitle: Constitutional avoidance in defining delegated power
summary: Constitutional avoidance favors an available statutory reading that avoids serious constitutional doubt.
notes:
The technique operates through interpretation before invalidation. Amalgamated Meat Cutters resists the union’s claim that Congress authorized arbitrary and unfair administration, relying on statutory purpose and constitutional concerns. Whitman supplies a limit: a court may choose only among readings the text can reasonably bear.

A constitutional concern cannot justify inserting cost consideration into a provision that unambiguously directs a health-based standard. Separately determine the plausible statutory readings, the constitutional difficulty, and whether the proposed reading genuinely resolves it. An explanation should identify which step is doing the work rather than use avoidance as a conclusion.
